about: Locations proven reachable in the hub (world_mode: hub), per game: tools/ap_late_proof.py --state hub (docs/handoff/hubproof.md; docs/ap/apworld.md 'Hub mode'). The late proof's search from the hub's New Game state (hub_state.json, built by the port: SS_HUB_STATE) with a hub seed (every chamber row of hub_bosses.json, the chapter lock on, no door locked) and the start map as the root; the party is the hero alone. 'rows': every location proven, its dungeon and key; 'comparison': against late_proof.json; 'lock_drops': every chapter / step store the lock dropped.
